primitives.name: Tiered Gate System
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Map of this OS - **Section 1 — Quality + Consistency:** tiered gates, per-format rubrics, slot-by-slot templates, platform variants, measurement + KEEP/CHANGE/CUT thresholds, lessons ledger, weekly review, Fake Door protocol, consistency system.
primitives.assumptions: Content passes through discrete quality tiers with defined rubrics; failure at any tier prevents shipment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When a piece fails the floor gate, it cannot proceed to any volume target.

layer2.mapping: Each tier corresponds to a probabilistic threshold in GSI's content trust model; consistency and quality metrics align with GSE's production state space.
layer2.telemetry: Pass/fail status of each tiered gate as recorded in the measurement ledger.

primitives.name: Consistency Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Consistency is structure:** templates, cadence, naming, versioning, asset library, measurement ledger, weekly review (Sections 1–2).
primitives.assumptions: Operational consistency is enforced via structured templates and cadenced workflows.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure to adhere to templates or cadence results in rejection or rework.

layer2.mapping: Templates and cadence form a kernel of deterministic behavior in GSE's production process, enabling scalable and reproducible content generation.
layer2.telemetry: Adherence to naming/versioning standards and template compliance scores.

primitives.name: Humanization Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **The product is the reasoning** (Reasoning Doctrine): content carries what the engine weighed, what it discounted, and why — in plain human words.
primitives.assumptions: Content must reflect human reasoning and empathy, even when generated by AI.
primitives.breakdown_regime: AI-generated content must include explicit reasoning traces to meet humanization criteria.

layer2.mapping: Humanization constraint maps to GSI's interpretability layer, ensuring that AI outputs are grounded in human-readable logic and emotional resonance.
layer2.telemetry: Presence and clarity of reasoning traces in content output.
